messages:
jin: Quick heads-up — sketching a compact mode for the routing rules list to reduce vertical scroll. Want quick reactions before I wire it up. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/compact-routing-mode
maria: Quick read: love the density but worried about discoverability of the "move priority" affordance when rows get condensed. Maybe a persistent drag handle on the left?
sam: Agree with maria. Also we need to preserve the evaluation order in the preview even if UI reflows. Preview must reflect truth, not visual grouping.
devon: Keyboard flow: condensed rows should still be tabbable per rule. Proposal: collapse into groups but expose a "step into group" button that opens a mini-list in a dialog or inline expander.
aria-ux: Accessibility checklist: 1) collapse toggle gets aria-expanded, 2) groups expose aria-controls to the list, 3) when step-into is used set focus to the first rule in group, 4) announce "Group expanded, 4 rules" in aria-live polite. Avoid shifting focus unexpectedly.
aria-ux: Microcopy suggestion for the expander: "4 rules collapsed — expand to reorder or edit". For the drag handle tooltip: "Drag to change evaluation priority".
alex: Implementation notes: keep stable data-rule-id attributes in DOM so analytics and feature flags don't think a reorder happened when visual grouping toggles. Debounce preview calls on UX toggles to prevent extra evals: debounce(runPreview, 250).
jin: Regarding the preview: what if a validation error exists inside a collapsed group — how should we surface it?
maria: Show an inline validation pill on the collapsed row (red dot + short text). On hover or focus, reveal the rule title that causes the error.
sam: UX win: when a validation line is clicked, highlight the exact rule in the preview with a temporary pulse and scroll-to. If it's in a collapsed group, auto-expand that group.
devon: Important keyboard detail: hitting Enter on a collapsed group should expand it and focus the first editable element. Hitting Space on the validation pill should toggle the preview highlight.
alex: We'll need to ensure preview expansion is client-side only and idempotent. The preview engine should accept a stable ordering array — even if the UI groups them, we pass the canonical list.
design-bot: Uploaded screenshot: https://imgur.com/example2 — shows compact rows with count badge and drag handle.
aria-ux: Accessibility nit: when preview updates after edits, announce "Preview updated" only once (polite). Avoid saying "Preview updated" for every small change. Implement a brief debounce on live-region updates.
maria: Copy tweak for validation messages: instead of "Rule invalid" use "Conflicts with higher-priority rule 'Rate limit heavy clients' — disable or move it above to apply." Short version: "Conflicts with rule above — move or disable."
sam: Small interaction ask: add a hover affordance in preview that reveals which policy line caused the simulated decision (chevron + highlight).
devon: Performance: collapsing large numbers of rules should not recreate DOM nodes unnecessarily. Use CSS transforms where possible and keep elements mounted hidden via aria-hidden.
jin: Action items: aria-ux to write final microcopy and live-region behavior; dev to prototype compact grouping with stable rule ids and preview idempotency; sam/devon to demo hover-to-highlight and keyboard step-in in the follow-up. I'll schedule a 30m review tomorrow afternoon. Thanks! :thumbsup:
